description: Keep generated photos for the current project in a gallery, then make the next one from the panel or from chat. People profiles store selfies and body details so a named person stays recognizable. Nano Banana 2, Nano Banana Pro, and Muse Image run through fal.ai or kie.ai; those providers bill generation, and Muse Image is fal.ai only. The chat Send form remembers the last model, frame, and size. English and Russian UI; Env Catalog can hold the keys.
